title: NVIDIA Recasts US$100b OpenAI Plan While Broadening AI Partnerships
text: NVIDIA (NasdaqGS:NVDA) is no longer moving ahead with a previously floated US$100b investment in OpenAI in its original form. The plan is now expected to be significantly smaller or reshaped after internal concerns and a reassessment of terms. CEO Jensen Huang has described the original commitment as non binding and highlighted business discipline as a key factor in the rethink.
